parameters: "Well, this is a short mountain pass - It just ends, right here.
Hey \P[1], do you think you could put on your dragon wings and check this place out from above?  Maybe see if there's a cave entrance, or some
place to go to, or inside of around here, or something?"
"This shouldn't be like at the Castle of The Dark, in Benny's last world.  I'll be right back."
A few moments later, and you're back.
"Um, there's really nothing here.  No cave, no building, no shrine, no bridge over the volcano, no monument or magic relic, nothing.
I flew over the volcano's top and looked in, and just saw lava, no island or anything special in the middle.  I could only fly so low.
I may be fireproof, but lava's too hot and could kill me, and that sucker spits it up into the air out of the top!"
"Like I said, there's nothing special here, and nothing for us to do.  Let's head back."
There's still nothing special here, and nothing for you to do here, at least for now.  Sorry.
This cave doesn't appear to have any opening large enough for you to get in.  The fact that you happen to be a skinny guy doesn't help.
Alice steps up.  You remember her saying she has the pass-code or something.
With a rumbling and moving of earth, the rock parts, and now there is an opening large enough for your party to enter.
"Hey, I didn't come up with the pass phrase, your pal Benny did!  But it worked!"
